trigger_cases.prompt: Make this dashboard responsive across phone, tablet, and desktop.
Replace device-specific media queries with a breakpoint strategy.
Audit this component for container-query behavior.
Scale the database for mobile traffic.

binary_cases.pass_rule: Every target width has no horizontal scrolling and retains the core task.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Verify all target widths, including phone, have no horizontal scroll and keep the core task visible and usable.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Test desktop only and let mobile users pan horizontally.

binary_cases.pass_rule: Breakpoints follow content failure rather than named devices and remain minimal.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Add minimal breakpoints only where content or interaction design breaks; prefer fewer breakpoints.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Add an iPhone 14 breakpoint and other device-specific rules.

binary_cases.prompt: Make a reusable card adapt inside grids and sidebars.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Component behavior follows container width, uses a fluid layout, and preserves touch usability.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Use a container query so the card adapts to container width, keep the layout fluid, and preserve usable tap targets.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Give every card a fixed card width and change it only from viewport media queries.
